pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with sharp pixel gradients and multi-angular vertices. The geometry is dominated by non-rounded, contiguous dark regions of high spatial area relative to the inter-patch pathways.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of cream-colored pathways with tri-radial junction nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the neck and upper flank, forming a consistent topological grid.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck mane. Individual hair tufts create a jagged 1D contour against the green foliage background.
